info.comments: Wails v2.12.0. Frontend lives OUTSIDE the Wails project root per the topic-sliced layout (condura-mind/CLAUDE.md.legacy §29.5.4). skipfrontend: true is set because (a) the build-gui.sh script runs the full npm ci + vite build BEFORE invoking wails, using absolute paths in $FRONTEND_DIR; (b) wails's relative-path frontend:* commands resolve against different CWDs between install and build steps and break with our topic-sliced layout. The ../../../cd paths are kept for fallback if skipfrontend is ever toggled off.
